# Cosmetics

Skins change how your dice and ball look. They are only for looks and never change a roll.

## Colours

Everyone can paint their dice and ball with these colours for free, on top of any skin:

<div class="rr-swatches"><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(186, 74, 232)"></i>Void</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(238, 70, 70)"></i>Scarlet</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(255, 174, 54)"></i>Sunburst</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(128, 226, 96)"></i>Verdant</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(108, 236, 200)"></i>Mint</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(66, 168, 255)"></i>Azure</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(255, 106, 156)"></i>Rose</div><div class="rr-swatch"><i style="--c: rgb(244, 242, 250)"></i>Pearl</div></div>
